subject: pathology
title: Intestinal pathology: malabsorption, IBD, polyps and Hirschsprung

steps.tx: **Coeliac disease** (HLA-DQ2 and DQ8, gluten gliadin, **tTG IgA** with total IgA checked, **villous atrophy** with intraepithelial lymphocytes) causes iron deficiency, diarrhoea and failure to thrive with **dermatitis herpetiformis** (itchy extensor vesicles, dapsone) and **refractory sprue with enteropathy lymphoma** risk; **gluten free diet** heals with serology followed. **Whipple disease** (Tropheryma whipplei, **PAS positive** foamy macrophages, arthralgia with diarrhoea and nodes, CNS oculomasticatory) needs prolonged **ceftriaxone then cotrimoxazole**; SIBO (blind loops, B12 low with folate high, breath tests, rifaximin) and disaccharidase deficiency complete malabsorption.
steps.say: Villous flattening with tTG positivity is coeliac: gluten free for life. PAS foamy macrophages with joints are Whipple: long antibiotics.

steps.tx: **Crohn disease** (mouth to anus, **skip lesions** with **creeping fat** and strictures, **transmural** with **noncaseating granulomas**, cobblestoning, fistulas, smoking worsens) differs from **ulcerative colitis** (rectum upward continuous, **crypt abscesses** with goblet depletion, toxic megacolon, smoking protects, **primary sclerosing cholangitis** associates). UC bleeds superficially; Crohn obstructs and fistulises. Treatment steps mesalazine (UC), steroids, thiopurines, **anti TNF and vedolizumab or ustekinumab**; surgery colectomises UC curatively while Crohn recurs. Colonoscopy with biopsies sorts.
steps.say: Skip transmural fistulising is Crohn; continuous rectal bleeding is UC. Smoking harms Crohn, shields UC.

steps.tx: **Colorectal polyps** sort malignant potential: hyperplastic (serrated benign, distal), **adenomas** (tubular, tubulovillous, villous with worst risk, size and high grade dysplasia drive), sessile serrated (BRAF, right sided, interval cancers), hamartomatous (juvenile, Peutz-Jeghers STK11 with mucocutaneous pigment, Cowden PTEN). **APC pathway** (chromosomal instability, FAP with hundreds of polyps and desmoids, prophylactic colectomy) differs from **microsatellite instability** (**HNPCC Lynch** with MSH2 and MLH1, right sided with endometrial and ovarian tumours, Amsterdam criteria, aspirin debates). Snare with surveillance intervals prevents.
steps.say: Villous large polyps threaten most. Hundreds of polyps with desmoids are FAP: colectomy prevents.

steps.tx: **Hirschsprung disease** (aganglionic distal bowel from failed neural crest migration, **RET** mutations, Down association, male predominance) presents with delayed meconium, bilious vomiting and enterocolitis; **suction biopsy** (absent ganglia with hypertrophic nerves, calretinin lost) confirms with transition zone on contrast enema. Treatment is pull through (Swenson, Soave, Duhamel) resecting to ganglionic bowel. **Mesenteric ischaemia** (AF emboli with pain out of proportion and lactic acidosis, watershed ischaemic colitis) and Ogilvie pseudo obstruction complete emergencies.
steps.say: No meconium in 48 hours with transition zone is Hirschsprung: biopsy then pull through. Pain out of proportion is mesenteric ischaemia.
